name: Vigil Restoration
description: Keep an unbroken vigil of qi over a mortally wounded ally until the body has recovered itself.

name: Undimmed Revival
description: Rekindle a life that has only just dimmed with a clear unwavering pulse of qi into the chest.

name: Primal Purification
description: Wash an ally of curse and taint with primal qi that touches the oldest layers of the body.

name: Abiding Salvation
description: Abide beside a lost ally and pour qi into the failing body until it has been saved.

name: Seamless Wholeness
description: Make an ally whole without a seam or scar so that no trace of the injury remains.

name: Pristine Cleansing
description: Cleanse a body so fully of every impurity that it is as pristine as at birth.

name: Ageless Remedy
description: Give an ally a remedy that holds age and wear at bay while the healing sets.

name: Wholesome Resurgence
description: Raise a ruined body into wholesome strength with a single sweep of unending qi.

name: Eternal Mercy
description: Pour mercy that does not seem to end into every ally the healer can see.

name: Unending Benediction
description: Bless the wounded with a benediction of qi that goes on mending after the healer has stopped.

name: Boundless Wholeness
description: Spread wholeness over a multitude of broken allies in one vast release up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Unwritten Wound
description: Unwrite the cause of one ally's wound so it was never dealt; a rewriting no energy mechanic explains and a Part 27 consequence event.

name: Sacred Recovery
description: Hold the sacred rhythm of the healer's qi over a broken ally until each wound is sealed.

name: Ancestral Revival
description: Call an ally from the first threshold of death with qi that carries the memory of many healers before.

name: Absolute Purification
description: Purify a body so completely that no trace of taint remains in any layer of flesh or qi.

name: Perennial Restoration
description: Restore an ally season after season of damage in a single long return to flowering health.

name: Everlasting Remedy
description: Give an everlasting remedy to an ally that keeps healing through the deepest damage without fading.

name: Primordial Absolution
description: Wash from an ally the stain of a curse laid at the root of its lineage.

name: Resplendent Resurgence
description: Raise a dying ally in a burst of resplendent qi that leaves the body shining with health.

name: Timeless Salve
description: Lay a salve of timeless qi on a lasting injury and watch the years of damage lift.

name: Immaculate Mercy
description: Grant immaculate mercy to the wounded with a calm pure outpouring of qi.

name: Sacred Benediction
description: Speak a sacred benediction that sinks into the wounded as warmth and leaves them healed.

name: Perpetual Dawn
description: Raise a dawn of qi that does not set while the healer stands and mends all in its light.

name: Infinite Restoration
description: Restore a vast multitude of wounded at once with a flood of qi up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Great Recall
description: Recall every ally in reach from the widest window of death the tier permits and set their hearts beating.

name: Death Unwritten
description: Unwrite the death of one ally fallen within the hour so the body lives; no energy mechanic explains it; a Part 27 consequence event.

name: Origin Mending
description: Mend one old permanent ruin of body or dantian back to its origin; no energy mechanic explains it; a Part 27 consequence event.
